verses.pali: Atha kho āyasmā rādho yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṁ abhivādetvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho āyasmā rādho bhagavantaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: Then Venerable Rādha went up to the Buddha, bowed, sat down to one side, and said to him:
“Sir, they speak of this thing called ‘Māra’.

verses.pali: “Rūpe kho, rādha, sati māro vā assa māretā vā yo vā pana mīyati.
verses.english: “When there is form, Rādha, there would be Māra, or the murderer, or the murdered.

verses.pali: Tasmātiha tvaṁ, rādha, rūpaṁ māroti passa, māretāti passa, mīyatīti passa, rogoti passa, gaṇḍoti passa, sallanti passa, aghanti passa, aghabhūtanti passa.
verses.english: So you should see form as Māra, the murderer, the murdered, the diseased, the boil, the dart, the gloom, the gloominess.

verses.pali: Ye naṁ evaṁ passanti te sammā passanti.
verses.english: Those who see it like this see rightly.

verses.pali: viññāṇe sati māro vā assa māretā vā yo vā pana mīyati.
verses.english: consciousness, there may be Māra, or the murderer, or the murdered.

verses.pali: Tasmātiha tvaṁ, rādha, viññāṇaṁ māroti passa, māretāti passa, mīyatīti passa, rogoti passa, gaṇḍoti passa, sallanti passa, aghanti passa, aghabhūtanti passa.
verses.english: So you should see consciousness as Māra, the murderer, the murdered, the diseased, the boil, the dart, the gloom, the gloominess.

verses.pali: Ye naṁ evaṁ passanti, te sammā passantī”ti.
verses.english: Those who see it like this see rightly.”
“But sir, what’s the purpose of seeing rightly?”
“Disillusionment is the purpose of seeing rightly.”
“But sir, what is the purpose of extinguishment?”

verses.pali: “Accayāsi, rādha, pañhaṁ, nāsakkhi pañhassa pariyantaṁ gahetuṁ.
verses.english: “Your question goes too far, Rādha. You weren’t able to grasp the limit of questioning.

verses.pali: Nibbānogadhañhi, rādha, brahmacariyaṁ vussati, nibbānaparāyanaṁ nibbānapariyosānan”ti.
verses.english: For extinguishment is the objective, destination, and culmination of the spiritual life.”
